def filebrowser(request):
    """
    JavaScript callback function for `django-filebrowser`_

    :param request: Django http request
    :type request: django.http.request.HttpRequest
    :return: Django http response with filebrowser JavaScript code for for TinyMCE 4
    :rtype: django.http.HttpResponse

    .. _django-filebrowser: https://github.com/sehmaschine/django-filebrowser
    """
    from django.template import loader
    from django.template.context import Context

    # Get the filebrowser JavaScript code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.js')
    js = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser CSS code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.css')
    css = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser jQuery code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.jquery.js')
    jquery = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser TinyMCE code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.tinymce.js')
    tinymce = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser TinyMCE CSS code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.tinymce.css')
    tinymce_css = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser TinyMCE language code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.tinymce.lang.js')
    tinymce_lang = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser TinyMCE plugins code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.tinymce.plugins.js')
    tinymce_plugins = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser TinyMCE themes code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.tinymce.themes.js')
    tinymce_themes = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser TinyMCE skins code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.tinymce.skins.js')
    tinymce_skins = t.render(Context())

    # Get the filebrowser TinyMCE plugins CSS code
    t = loader.get_template('filebrowser/filebrowser.tinymce.plugins.css')
    tinymce_plugins_css = t.render(Context())
